newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian interbank rates steady in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian interbank rates steady in slow trade.

text.p: Croatian interbank rates were steady on Tuesday amid a slower trade and high supply, dealers said.
"Today was much calmer than Monday. We didn't have a very large demand," dealer Jasenka Blagaic told Reuters.
She said morning trade totalled 22 million kuna, mostly fresh loans against almost twice as much on the supply side.
Of this, 16 million were call money borrowings at 10.5 percent. Term rates ranged between 9.0 percent for insurers' money and 16 percent for one-month interbank funds.
Monday's overnight trade totalled 100 million kuna, sought by one bank for mandatory reserve payment. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom 385-1-4557075
